scope: Read-only review of the existing current-base B8 hot profile and actual imported source. No model, backward, optimizer, checkpoint restore, new profile, parameter change or production modification.
conclusion: No repeated parameter all-gather or device transfer was found between the same B4 decoder replay and its finite consumer. Current owner already preserves that decoder through the official FSDP2 reshard setter and releases it after finite propagation.

producer.verified_by: Direct standard-library read of the actual remote file; matches existing profile imported_sources.dt_producer and current formal source binding.

torch_fsdp_param_group.verified_by: Direct standard-library read of actual installed PyTorch source, without importing torch.

source_evidence.observation: replay_finite_layer temporarily calls public module.set_reshard_after_forward(False, recurse=False), then restores the prior mesh/auto settings after replay without releasing gathered parameters.
prepare_finite_layer calls public unshard; release_finite_layer calls public reshard only after the finite consumer.
Native root forward gathers are released; root-owned head/final norm are explicitly materialized for the following seed. This review does not assume all decoder weights may remain resident.
Original order is native layer replay, prepare_finite_layer, decoder_finite_pullback, release_finite_layer.
unshard returns immediately for an already pending gather or an already unsharded parameter group.
reshard returns during FORWARD when reshard_after_forward is false.
The installed official public setter updates post-forward mesh information and disables automatic override.

trace_evidence.direct_read: Parsed existing trace JSON only; counted original CPU user_annotation FSDP::all_gather scopes, with copy_out scopes excluded.
trace_evidence.interpretation: Each decoder gathers once in the original root forward and once in reverse replay; no third decoder gather was observed for the finite consumer.
trace_evidence.inside_test: Same CPU tid, with collective CPU-op timestamp contained in the original DT_native_prepare_finite_layer_* interval.

collective_byte_scope: Exact collective bytes are not available from these trace collective CPU arguments, which contain only External id, Record function id and Ev Idx. Total HtoD bytes are not a substitute for collective bytes or parameter-only bytes.

already_reviewed_official_reuse.current_replay_finite_weight_reuse: Already integrated through official set_reshard_after_forward(False), not an omitted candidate.

reverse_prefetch.conclusion: Current long-case official set_modules_to_forward_prefetch trial had no end-to-end benefit and was not deployed; it is not evidence of an omitted effective optimization.

limits: Observations belong to this original current-base hot B8 case, with B4 per rank; they are not a claim about every formal training batch.
The 3.63681024-second rank1 all-gather device-duration sum includes inter-rank wait/skew and cannot be treated as removable time.
GPU duration sums can overlap across streams and are not wall-time savings.
No new whole-network numerical threshold, correction or all-weights-resident policy is proposed.
Unknown device-to-CPU links are not asserted absent; prepare/release ranges, explicit collective call counts and original source jointly support the narrow no-third-gather conclusion.
No specific fixable replay-to-finite parameter-lifecycle waste was found; this does not establish that all DT work is optimal.
